latestVersion.changelog:
**Summary:** RapidOCR skill v1.0.3 introduces a new Node.js wrapper and updates usage instructions for improved clarity and reliability.

- Added a wrapper script (`run_rapidocr.py`) for orchestrating OCR tasks via Node.js.
- Updated documentation to focus on local image OCR only; dropped support details for remote URLs and PDFs.
- Streamlined command execution and output handling (plain text or JSON).
- Clarified dependency and installation instructions for easier troubleshooting.
- Improved guidance on when and how to use the skill.
